cards.claim: Astrid de Groot was listed on the focus list for the WikiProject Badminton on Wikipedia.
cards.quote: It was from a user named "RacketRanger" on a website called Wikipedia, requesting Astrid's input on a badminton tournament focus list. Jasmijn raised an eyebrow, wondering how this online community had discovered Astrid's secret love for the sport. Astrid, however, was intrigued. She had always been fascinated by the way badminton brought people together, transcending borders and cultures. As she delved deeper into the WikiProject Badminton\/tournament focus list, she was impressed by the dedication of its contributors.

raw_card.claim: Astrid de Groot is featured on the focus list of the Wikimedia project NL Gendergap maintenance.
